message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Build

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: build-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
      - name: Setup env
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup_env
      - name: Build & Zip exe
        id: build_zip
        uses: ./.github/actions/build_zip
        with:
          version: ${{ github.sha }}
      - name: Upload zip artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7.0.2
        with:
          name: d4lf_v${{ steps.build_zip.outputs.version }}
          path: ${{ steps.build_zip.outputs.zip_path }}",
  "rationale": "The workflow already defines a concurrency group but does not cancel in-progress runs. Adding cancel-in-progress with a branch-partitioned group (build-${{ github.ref }}) implements the P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE pattern: when a newer workflow_dispatch build is triggered on the same branch, the superseded older run is canceled, saving CI resources while the new run still completes fully and preserves all build steps and artifact coverage. Partitioning by github.ref avoids the pattern's contraindication of distinct branches sharing a cancellation group. No permissions are weakened, no privileged actions, secrets, publishing, or new network access are added.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE"]
}
